# Keyala

> Keyala lets an app use a person's own OpenAI, Anthropic or OpenRouter API key without receiving it: the user approves on their phone, your app calls the official SDK with a scoped grant token and a different base URL. Experimental beta, free.

The full developer documentation is one Markdown file:

- [Keyala developer docs](https://keyala.io/docs/keyala.md): what it is, 5-minute quickstart (register an app, connect a user, call OpenAI, Anthropic or OpenRouter, handle pending approval), grants and policies, supported models, error table, usage dashboard and report API, endpoint reference, self-hosting, limits.

## Sections

- Quickstart: POST /v1/apps, POST /v1/connect, web SDK https://app.keyala.io/sdk/keyala.js, base_url https://app.keyala.io/v1/openai or /v1/anthropic
- Errors: JSON {"error":{"type","message"}} with the code table
- Dashboard: GET /v1/app/report (totals, daily, models, countries, hours_utc)
